vulnerabilities.title: Project MONAI MONAI Label
vulnerabilities.name: Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.title: N-able MailAssure
vulnerabilities.name: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
